decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls or roof of the extension permitted.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding any details pertaining to windows shown on the submitted plans, elevational drawings of the front and north side elevations of the extension to scale 1:20 showing the detailed position and design of the windows, shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning authority before the development is commenced.  The development shall only be carried out in accordance with the details as may subsequently be approved.

Condition : 5 - The window of the extension facing north shall only be provided in obscure glass, and  shall be fixed, i.e. non-openable, to a point 1.8 metres above floor level, and shall be retained only as provided.
description: Erection of single storey extension to front of house, and use of integral garage as habitable room.
